title: Tokyo markets closed — Respect for the Aged Day; it falls on the Russell Q3 2027 review's own effective open
source: NEWS: jpx.co.jp/english/corporate/about-jpx/calendar/ ('Market Holidays'), fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 33,103 bytes — the same byte count the jpx-market-closure-2027-03-22 entry recorded on 2026-09-05, which is the check that the page has not moved) and parsed row-by-row out of its 2027 panel by this session. The 2027 panel reads, in order around the date: 'Jul. 19 (Mon.) Marine Day | Aug. 11 (Wed.) Mountain Day | **Sep. 20 (Mon.) Respect for the Aged Day** | Sep. 23 (Thu.) Autumnal Equinox | Oct. 11 (Mon.) Sports Day | Nov. 3 (Wed.) Culture Day'. The weekday labels are the disambiguation that this is the 2027 panel and not the adjacent 2026 one, which reads 'Sep. 21 (Mon.) Respect for the Aged Day / Sep. 22 (Tue.) Holiday / Sep. 23 (Wed.) Autumnal Equinox'. CORROBORATED BY AN INDEPENDENT STATUTORY PRIMARY SOURCE, fetched direct 2026-09-09: the Japanese Cabinet Office's own national-holiday register (www8.cao.go.jp/chosei/shukujitsu/syukujitsu.csv, HTTP 200, 21,538 bytes, Shift-JIS), the publisher of record for holidays under the Act on National Holidays, lists the row '2027/9/20,敬老の日' (Respect for the Aged Day) and '2027/9/23,秋分の日' (Autumnal Equinox Day). Its full 2027 block reproduces the JPX panel date-for-date. Independently reproduced by statute and weekday arithmetic: the Happy Monday System fixes Respect for the Aged Day on the THIRD MONDAY in September, and the Mondays of September 2027 are the 6th, 13th, 20th and 27th. Filed estimate on the same three counts the sibling jpx-market-closure-2027-03-22 documented: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for a securities exchange's or a foreign cabinet office's own holiday calendar, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and JPX's own note warns 'Exchange holidays are subject to change due to changes to national holidays under Japan's Act on National Holidays'. The DATE is not in doubt — the estimate label is about the taxonomy, not the evidence. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of russell-quarterly-ipo-review-effective-2027-09-20, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the russell-quarterly-ipo-review-effective-2027-09-20 initial research (2026-09-09). WHY IT EARNS A SLOT, and it is the same reason jpx-market-closure-2027-03-22 earned one: it falls on the proposer's OWN effective open, so it decides which instrument that session can be read on. The March sibling's effective open, 2027-03-22, is likewise a JPX closure — meaning BOTH of the tracked 2027 instances of the Russell quarterly review land on a Tokyo holiday, which is not a coincidence but a collision of two Monday rules (Russell's effective open is the Monday after the third Friday; Japan's Happy Monday System puts Respect for the Aged Day on the third Monday of September and moves Vernal Equinox observance to a Monday). STRUCTURAL CONSEQUENCE, stated narrowly: Tokyo's week of 2027-09-20 starts on TUESDAY 09-21, so the 09-21 Nikkei bar absorbs a three-day gap of US news — the 2027-09-15 FOMC aftermath and the 2027-09-17 quarterly triple witching (opex-2027-09-17, high, confirmed) — while the US 09-20 session, the one the Russell review actually prints into, trades normally. INHERITED, NOT RE-VERIFIED FOR SEPTEMBER: the jpx-market-closure-2027-03-22 ledger established that JPX derivatives holiday trading keeps Osaka index futures and index options open on a cash-market holiday while JGB futures, interest-rate futures and securities options stay dark, and that JPX welds the preceding Friday night session, the holiday session and the following day session into one trading day for price-limit purposes. A taking lane should re-fetch the 2027 holiday-trading eligibility table rather than assume September 2027 is listed the same way; this proposal asserts only the CASH closure, which is what both primary sources actually state. IMPACT IS LOW and structural only: a day one exchange is shut moves nothing by itself, no house playbook is calendar-keyed, and symbols is empty. It changes how many sessions the surrounding flows clear in and which close-to-close bar is uncontaminated, never direction. HONEST LIMIT ON THE KIND FIELD: EventKind (src/domain/market-events-types.ts) has no slot for an exchange-schedule event, so this is filed 'sector', the same least-wrong choice good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 and jpx-market-closure-2027-03-22 both documented; this is a further data point for the open question of whether the union needs a 'market-structure' member, not a new ask.
